---
title: "Color palettes"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
import attaviz
from IPython.display import Markdown
attaviz.enable()

def swatch(colors, labels=None, height=40):
    """Render a horizontal strip of color swatches."""
    if isinstance(colors, dict):
        labels = list(colors.keys())
        values = list(colors.values())
    else:
        values = list(colors)
        labels = labels or [f"{i}" for i in range(len(values))]
    df = pd.DataFrame({"i": list(range(len(values))), "label": labels, "hex": values})
    return (
        alt.Chart(df)
        .mark_rect()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("i:O", axis=None),
            color=alt.Color(
                "label:N",
                scale=alt.Scale(domain=labels, range=values),
                legend=None,
            ),
            tooltip=["label", "hex"],
        )
        .properties(width=alt.Step(60), height=height)
    )

def hex_table(*names):
    """Render palettes as a Markdown table so the hex values exist as text."""
    palettes = [getattr(attaviz, n) for n in names]
    if len(names) > 1:  # equal-length ramps side by side
        rows = ["| Step | " + " | ".join(f"`{n}`" for n in names) + " |",
                "|---" * (len(names) + 1) + "|"]
        rows += [f"| {i} | " + " | ".join(f"`{p[i]}`" for p in palettes) + " |"
                 for i in range(len(palettes[0]))]
    else:
        pal = palettes[0]
        items = pal.items() if isinstance(pal, dict) else enumerate(pal)
        rows = ["| Key | Hex |", "|---|---|"]
        rows += [f"| `{k}` | " + (", ".join(f"`{c}`" for c in v) if isinstance(v, list) else f"`{v}`") + " |"
                 for k, v in items]
    return Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```

## Categorical

The default 9-color palette used automatically when the theme is enabled.

```{python}
#| echo: false
swatch(attaviz.CATEGORICAL)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("CATEGORICAL")
```

An accessible text-contrast variant is available when categorical colors are
applied to text rather than marks:

```{python}
#| echo: false
swatch(attaviz.CATEGORICAL_TEXT)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("CATEGORICAL_TEXT")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("BINARY")
```

```python
attaviz.CATEGORICAL       # 9-color palette (default)
attaviz.CATEGORICAL_TEXT  # high-contrast text variant
attaviz.BINARY            # two-color pair
```

## Sequential

Five monochrome ramps. Use with `alt.Scale(range=...)`:

```python
alt.Chart(data).mark_rect().encode(
    color=alt.Color("value:Q", scale=alt.Scale(range=attaviz.SEQ_GREEN))
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
alt.vconcat(
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_BLUE,   labels=[f"blue-{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_BLUE))]).properties(title="SEQ_BLUE"),
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_GREEN,  labels=[f"green-{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_GREEN))]).properties(title="SEQ_GREEN"),
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_PURPLE, labels=[f"purple-{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_PURPLE))]).properties(title="SEQ_PURPLE"),
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_YELLOW, labels=[f"yellow-{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_YELLOW))]).properties(title="SEQ_YELLOW"),
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_RED,    labels=[f"red-{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_RED))]).properties(title="SEQ_RED"),
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("SEQ_BLUE", "SEQ_GREEN", "SEQ_PURPLE", "SEQ_YELLOW", "SEQ_RED")
```

Two semantic sequential ramps convey "good → bad" direction:

```{python}
#| echo: false
alt.vconcat(
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_BAD_TO_GOOD, labels=[f"{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_BAD_TO_GOOD))]).properties(title="SEQ_BAD_TO_GOOD (higher = better)"),
    swatch(attaviz.SEQ_GOOD_TO_BAD, labels=[f"{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.SEQ_GOOD_TO_BAD))]).properties(title="SEQ_GOOD_TO_BAD (higher = worse)"),
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("SEQ_BAD_TO_GOOD", "SEQ_GOOD_TO_BAD")
```

## Diverging

Three diverging palettes with a neutral midpoint (`#EFEFEF`). Pair with
`domainMid=0` for symmetric scales centered at zero:

```python
alt.Chart(data).mark_bar().encode(
    color=alt.Color(
        "change:Q",
        scale=alt.Scale(range=attaviz.DIV_DEFAULT, domainMid=0),
    )
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
alt.vconcat(
    swatch(attaviz.DIV_DEFAULT,     labels=[f"{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.DIV_DEFAULT))]).properties(title="DIV_DEFAULT (red ↔ blue)"),
    swatch(attaviz.DIV_NEUTRAL,     labels=[f"{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.DIV_NEUTRAL))]).properties(title="DIV_NEUTRAL (teal ↔ purple)"),
    swatch(attaviz.DIV_ALTERNATIVE, labels=[f"{i}" for i in range(len(attaviz.DIV_ALTERNATIVE))]).properties(title="DIV_ALTERNATIVE (blue ↔ red)"),
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("DIV_DEFAULT", "DIV_NEUTRAL", "DIV_ALTERNATIVE")
```

## Semantic palettes

### Regions

```{python}
#| echo: false

```

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("REGIONS")
```

Text variants:

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("REGIONS_TEXT")
```

Secondary shades:

```{python}
#| echo: false
hex_table("REGIONS_SECONDARY")
```

```python
attaviz.REGIONS            # code → hex (e.g. "NAC", "SSF", ...)
attaviz.REGIONS_TEXT       # accessible text variants
attaviz.REGIONS_SECONDARY  # 4-shade series per region
```

Use in an explicit scale:

```python
regions = attaviz.REGIONS
alt.Chart(data).mark_bar().encode(
    color=alt.Color(
        "region:N",
        scale=alt.Scale(domain=list(regions), range=list(regions.values())),
    )
)
```

## Grey scale

Five greys used across the theme.

```{python}
#| echo: false
swatch({
    "GREY_500": attaviz.GREY_500,
    "GREY_400": attaviz.GREY_400,
    "GREY_300": attaviz.GREY_300,
    "GREY_200": attaviz.GREY_200,
    "GREY_100": attaviz.GREY_100,
})
```

| Constant | Hex | Typical use |
|---|---|---|
| `GREY_500` | `#111111` | primary text |
| `GREY_400` | `#666666` | secondary text |
| `GREY_300` | `#8A969F` | reference lines |
| `GREY_200` | `#CED4DE` | grid lines |
| `GREY_100` | `#EBEEF4` | backgrounds |

## Functional

```python
attaviz.REFERENCE            # "#8A969F" — reference line color
attaviz.NO_DATA              # "#CED4DE" — missing-data fill
attaviz.TOTAL                # "#163C6C" — total/aggregate color
attaviz.SELECTION_PRIMARY    # "#0071BC" — active selection
attaviz.SELECTION_SECONDARY  # "#8963C1" — companion selection color
attaviz.TEXT                 # "#111111" — primary text color
attaviz.TEXT_SUBTLE          # "#666666" — subtle text color (captions)
```
